cc:Work.dc:description: Finite-order Taylor price-enclosure radii for cap H=25 in the frozen synthetic two-, four- and eight-asset models. I calculate each radius from the exact retained undiscounted interval endpoints. The horizontal line is the certification threshold tau=0.01 in unspecified price currency units. The black ring marks the first integer degree that certifies this threshold. At lambda=0.05, no degree from zero to eight certifies the two-asset case; the corresponding H=10 case also fails this Taylor criterion and is resolved by the separately validated quadrature benchmark. Joined points are visual guides between tested integer degrees. These are enclosure radii, rather than observed pricing errors; the figure asserts neither convergence of an infinite Taylor series nor a practical quantum advantage.
